narrative_summary: The 30% annual inflation projection by BBVA reflects herd behavior among institutions, driven by monetary base expansion (12% real growth) and market bets on FMI recapitalization. Saturation in service price hikes (4.4% monthly) and exchange rate depreciation (1400 ARS/USD) amplified causal shocks, creating a feedback loop between currency devaluation and import-cost-driven inflation.
